svg.title: Entrust Clinic on WhatsApp, Nexacode AI, 2026
svg.desc: A WhatsApp assistant that books, reminds and follows up for a family clinic, plus the dashboard staff run the day from. Opens the case study at https://www.thiruvarankanm.work/work/entrust-clinic.
